_comment: Context Management block. Segments grouped across 2 lines for readability: (1) directory + git, (2) model + session(disabled, kept for future toggle) + context(disabled — statusline-gsd.sh renders the usage gauge) + block(enabled, Claude.ai 5-hour quota window) + today(disabled). The legacy 3rd 'agent' line was removed at v1.1 — it was always empty during normal operation (subagent-statusline.sh covers that signal). NOTE: claude-powerline.json is strict JSON — `//` comments break it and silently fall back to defaults; use `_comment` keys (ignored by the parser) instead.

segments._comment_today: today (daily $ cost) intentionally hidden — not used right now. To bring it back set today.enabled=true; the segment and its color are kept here for future use.
segments._comment_context: context segment disabled here — statusline-gsd.sh renders a 3-zone (green→amber→red) usage gauge in its place, fed by context_window.used_percentage. Re-enable here only if you drop the script gauge.
segments._comment_session: session segment disabled at v1.1 — replaced by `block` (5-hour rate-limit window utilization). Kept in config (enabled:false) so future toggles don't require resurrecting the segment entry.
segments._comment_block: block segment enabled at v1.1 (QUOTA-01). Powerline reads Claude Code's rate_limits hook. Default output is `◱ N% (Xh Ym)`. statusline-gsd.sh post-processes this into `§ N% used ↻ Nh` (or `↻ Nm` when <1h) and applies the 3-zone color rule to the N%.
segments._comment_weekly: weekly segment enabled at v1.2 — Claude.ai 7-day rolling-window quota (Max plan). Default output is `◑ N% (Xd Yh)` (or `Xh Ym` for sub-day resets). statusline-gsd.sh post-processes the segment's native shape into `N% used ↻ Nd Nh` and applies the 3-zone color rule to the N%, mirroring the v1.1 block-segment treatment. Silent fallback: when the rate_limits.seven_day hook is unavailable (Pro plan), powerline omits the segment and line 4 is hidden — same pattern as v1.1 block segment.
